source.note: 270 RPD markers. The data has no floor field; the floor comes from the latitude band of the stacked raster. The 14 Assisted/Standard-only ids are removed.

world.formula: x = (plan_x - ox) / s; z = (plan_y - oy) / s; y = level
world.y_is: floor surface level, not the item mesh centre

notes.on_floor: A plan.json floor box contains the point. Wall and furniture items are false. The B1 garage and parts of 3F are also false because the floor mesh leaves them out.
notes.nearest_nav: Distance to the nearest nav.json node on the same floor. Wall and furniture items are often more than 2 m from a node.
